title: Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant Down Payment Entry and Down Payment Room
content:
**Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant — size of the down payment entry**

The grant's available balance is its award entries less the application and reduction entries already on its ledger. The down payment is the property value less the base loan amount on the loan file. The borrower keeps an own-funds reserve in the down payment: the down payment room is the down payment less the reserve, never below zero, rounded down to the whole dollar. The own-funds reserve is the program's minimum borrower contribution, the figure the Closing Cost Credit schedule of borrower commitments gives the Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant. The down payment entry is the lesser of the grant's available balance and the down payment room, less any down payment entries the grant has already booked, never below zero, rounded to the cent.

### The calculation laid out

| Quantity | Definition |
|---|---|
| Available balance | award entries less application and reduction entries on the grant's ledger |
| Down payment | property value less base loan amount, both from the loan file |
| Down payment room | down payment less the own-funds reserve, never below zero, rounded down to the whole dollar |
| Down payment entry | the lesser of the available balance and the down payment room, less down payment entries already booked, never below zero, rounded to the cent |

### Worked example (hypothetical figures)

Property value 250000.00 and base loan amount 239499.50: the down payment is 10500.50. With a hypothetical own-funds reserve of 1000.00, the room is 9500.50 rounded down to the whole dollar, 9500.00. The grant's ledger carries an award entry of 5000.00 and an application entry of 1800.00, so the available balance is 3200.00. No down payment entry has been booked. The entry is the lesser of 3200.00 and 9500.00, which is 3200.00.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- A down payment of 800.00 against a reserve of 1000.00 leaves a room of 0.00, and the entry is 0.00.
- Where an earlier down payment entry of 3200.00 is already on the ledger and the lesser of the balance and the room is 3200.00, the entry is 0.00.
